title_zh: 严金海：全国人大常委会副委员长肖捷一行来藏调研
title_en: NPC Vice Chairperson Xiao Jie Leads Delegation to Tibet for Investigation
summary_zh: 7月27日，全国人大常委会副委员长肖捷一行赴西藏调研，自治区主席严金海陪同。
summary_en: On July 27, 2026, Xiao Jie, Vice Chairperson of the National People's Congress, led a delegation to Tibet for investigation, accompanied by Yan Jinhai, Chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region.
